<?php
class Stop117A extends Exception {}
class Token117A {
    function __construct() { global $weakToken; $weakToken = WeakReference::create($this); }
    function __destruct() { global $weak; echo 'TOKEN|', $weak->get() instanceof Generator, '|'; }
}
function stream117A() {
    try { $received = yield 'head'; unset($received); global $stop; throw $stop; }
    finally { global $weak; echo 'FIN|', $weak->get() instanceof Generator, '|'; }
}
function argument117A() { global $generator, $weak; $generator = null; echo 'HELD|', $weak->get() instanceof Generator, '|'; return new Token117A; }
function run117A() {
    global $generator, $weak, $weakToken, $stop;
    $result = 'waiting';
    try { $result = $generator->send(argument117A()); echo 'BAD|'; }
    catch (Stop117A $caught) { echo 'CATCH|', $caught === $stop, '|', $caught->getPrevious() === null, '|', $caught->getTrace() === [], '|', $result === 'waiting', '|', $weak->get() === null, '|', $weakToken->get() === null, '|'; }
}
$stop = new Stop117A('given'); $generator = stream117A(); $weak = WeakReference::create($generator);
run117A(); echo 'DONE|';
